card.name: Verb slot after 'if particulate matter'
card.fires_on: The linking verb (is, are) or the end of a noun such as discoloration, right after 'If particulate matter/leaks/discoloration' and before observed, found, evident or present.

card.plain: It fires in 'if particulate matter is ... seen' sentences, where the next word will be observed, found or noted.
